meta.name: hunt-cicd
meta.description: Hunt CI/CD pipeline vulnerabilities — GitHub Actions workflow injection (pull_request_target Pwnrequest + ${{ }}-into-shell), self-hosted runner poisoning, OIDC trust-policy abuse, Jenkins script-console RCE and CVE-2024-23897 file read, GitLab CI runner-token registration, Terraform state file leakage, artifact/log secret leakage, pipeline env-var disclosure. Use when target has a public GitHub/GitLab org, exposed CI dashboards (Jenkins/TeamCity/Drone/Argo), or build artifacts/images are reachable.

copy.tagline: 扫描 CI/CD 流水线中的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责 CI/CD 安全或需要审计流水线配置
copy.tagline_en: Scan CI/CD pipelines for security vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage CI/CD security or need to audit pipeline configurations

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你检查 CI/CD 流水线中的安全漏洞，比如 GitHub Actions 注入、Jenkins 远程代码执行、密钥泄露等，并给出利用步骤。
howto.when: 当目标有公开的 GitHub/GitLab 组织、暴露的 CI 面板（如 Jenkins、TeamCity），或可访问的构建产物/镜像时触发。

say.text: 检查这个 Jenkins 实例是否有未授权的脚本控制台。
say.note: Claude 会尝试访问 /script 并执行命令。

say.text: 扫描这个公开 S3 桶中的 Terraform 状态文件。
say.note: Claude 会下载并解析 tfstate 中的密钥。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you check CI/CD pipeline security vulnerabilities, such as GitHub Actions injection, Jenkins RCE, secret leaks, and provide exploitation steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target has a public GitHub/GitLab org, exposed CI dashboards (Jenkins, TeamCity, etc.), or reachable build artifacts/images.

say_en.text: Check if this Jenkins instance has an unauthenticated script console.
say_en.note: Claude will try to access /script and execute commands.

say_en.text: Analyze this GitHub repo's workflows for pull_request_target injection.
say_en.note: Claude will enumerate workflows and check for dangerous patterns.

say_en.text: Scan this public S3 bucket for Terraform state files.
say_en.note: Claude will download and parse tfstate for secrets.
